image_location_description: Upper right of torso (viewer’s right); arm angles inward to meet lightsaber grip.

steps.title: Shoulder base
steps.description: 3021 White x1 + 3023 White x1 + 3024 White x2 as a 2x3 shoulder pad.

steps.title: Anti-sag shoulder brace
steps.description: Layer 3023 White x2 crosswise + 3024 White x1 to stiffen the mount.

steps.title: Upper arm block
steps.description: Attach 3004 White x2 under shoulder; cap with 3023 White x1.

steps.title: Elbow angle inward
steps.description: Add 2420 White x1 as elbow corner + 3023 White x1 + 3024 White x2.

steps.title: Forearm + sleeve cuff
steps.description: Build forearm with 3005 White x2 + 3023 White x1 + 3034 White x1.

steps.title: Hand + saber grip point
steps.description: Add 15573 Tan x1 as hand + 11090 Black x1 grip + 3024 White x2 as lock plates.
